role_summary: I keep the shuttlebay running: I prep and fuel the shuttles, walk the deck for debris, clear the bay for launches and recoveries, and run the cargo sleds. Nobody notices a flight deck crewman until a shuttle doesn't come home, so I care about the checklist being done right, even at 0400.

personas.quirk: Reads every checklist line aloud, even alone.
personas.routine_effect: Never skips preflight walkaround; arrives early to handover; spends less time at the bar.

personas.quirk: Names each shuttle's squeaky hatch and talks to them.
personas.routine_effect: Lingers in mess and lounge; runs a few minutes late on rounds but never on launches.

personas.quirk: Keeps a thermos of bad coffee hidden behind the fuel locker.
personas.routine_effect: Rushes routine sweeps, takes naps in the bay office; sharp when it matters.

daily_template.note: Take the deck log and open-item list from the outgoing crew.
Inspect shuttles, tie-downs, hatch seals, and floor for debris.
Top off consumables, check suits and tools.
Mid-watch meal with whoever is off the deck.
Clear bay, cycle doors, marshal the pilot in and out.
Move sleds between cargo and bay as requested.
Brief the relief on every open item.
Keep the back strong for cargo work.
Letters home, shuttle manuals, a model kit.
Coffee and a bite before handover.

activities.label: Eat in the mess
activities.note: Sits with other deck and cargo hands.

activities.label: Drink at the rec bar
activities.note: One drink, a lot of talk about pilots.

activities.label: Holo-Playroom: open-sky glider
activities.note: Flies a program under open sky, since the deck has no windows.

activities.label: Sleep
activities.note: Hard sleeper once the hum settles.

activities.label: Lift weights
activities.note: Cargo work rewards a strong back.

activities.label: Walk the corridors
activities.note: Sits under the trees when the deck noise is in his ears.

activities.label: Tinker with a hover-sled in the workshop
activities.note: Job-specific hobby: rebuilds the bay's worn tow sled.

duty_loops.label: Shuttle walkaround and FOD sweep
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Flight Deck. Bay walkaround complete, shuttles ready.

duty_loops.label: Bay door and forcefield check
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Flight Deck. Bay seals hold, pressure steady.

quiet_watch.task: Routine deck walk and tie-down check
quiet_watch.if_neglected: A loose strap or oil leak sits unseen until the next launch.
Missing items found only in an emergency.

survey.task: Prep survey shuttle with probe pods
survey.if_neglected: Launch is delayed; survey window slips.

survey.task: Clear bay and cycle doors for launch
survey.if_neglected: Pilot launches into a cluttered bay or holds.

survey.task: Stand by for recovery and wash down probes
survey.if_neglected: Contaminated samples cross into the bay.

cargo_run.task: Stage cargo sleds at cargo bay
cargo_run.if_neglected: Loading backs up and the shuttle waits.
Cargo clogs the bay and blocks recovery.

medical_relief.task: Ready the shuttle for casualty transport
medical_relief.if_neglected: Patients are delayed leaving the ship.

medical_relief.task: Clear a stretcher lane to sickbay
medical_relief.if_neglected: Crates block the lane and slow the stretchers.

medical_relief.task: Meet returning shuttle with medical team

shakedown.task: Run full pre-launch checklist on all craft
Test bay door, forcefield and fire suppression
Drill emergency recovery with the pilot
shakedown.if_neglected: Crew untested for a rough landing.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Bay walkaround finds a defect on a shuttle
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Flight Deck. Shuttle hatch seal is leaking. Grounding it until repaired.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Bay is clear and ready for launch
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Flight Deck. Bay clear, doors ready for launch.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Bay pressure drops or doors misbehave
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Flight Deck. Bay pressure is falling. Request hold on all launches.
Pilot, Flight Deck. Shuttle fuel is under half. Need a resupply order.

calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Preflight would be skipped on a damaged craft.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Flight Deck. Aye, but I'd rather have five minutes for a checklist.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: A visible fuel leak or open hatch.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Flight Deck. Bay secure, all craft strapped down.

yellow.action: Strap down loose gear, finish fueling, ready the shuttle
yellow.comm_line: Flight Deck. Yellow. Shuttle is fueled and ready.

red.action: Seal the bay, stand by at the shuttle
red.comm_line: Flight Deck. Red. Bay sealed, standing by.

fire.action: Hit bay suppression, drag fuel hoses clear, evacuate if it spreads
fire.comm_line: Bridge, Flight Deck. Fire in the bay, suppression active.

hull_breach.action: Get to a suit locker, seal the inner door, hold on
hull_breach.comm_line: Bridge, Flight Deck. Breach in the bay. Sealing it off.

contamination.action: Shut bay doors, stay put with the shuttle sealed
contamination.comm_line: Flight Deck. Contamination. Bay is sealed.

power_failure.action: Hand-crank the door to hold, check pressure
power_failure.comm_line: Bridge, Flight Deck. Bay is on backup lights. Doors are holding.

gravity_failure.action: Grab a rail, brace the loose cargo
gravity_failure.comm_line: Bridge, Flight Deck. Gravity out in the bay. Securing loose cargo.

intruder.action: Lock the office, stay with the shuttle, report what I see
intruder.comm_line: Bridge, Flight Deck. Bay locked down. I'll call if anyone comes through.

medical_emergency.action: Clear the lane to sickbay and fetch a stretcher
medical_emergency.comm_line: Flight Deck. Lane is clear. Stretcher is on its way.

abandon_ship.action: Load shuttle with the pilot and launch crew onto it
abandon_ship.comm_line: Flight Deck. Shuttle is loaded. Bay doors opening on your word.

nominal.routine_change: Follows the standard rounds and takes breaks.

anomalies.routine_change: Does extra walkarounds, asks the pilot more questions.
lines: That hatch light has flickered twice now.
Something's off with the doors. Checking.

degraded.routine_change: Skips the break, stays by the shuttle, calls the bridge more often.
lines: Doors are sluggish. Keep clear of them.
I'm not launching anything I haven't checked.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Bay becomes unsafe or the pilot orders everyone out.

crisis.routine_change: Stays inside the bay, preps the shuttle for escape.
lines: Everyone gets a suit before they get a seat.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Fire, decompression, or the bay is lost.

collapse.routine_change: Single focus: get as many people as possible into the shuttle.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Only when the last person is aboard or the shuttle is gone.

relationships.effect: Takes orders from them; trusts their calls, pushes back politely on rushed launches.
Shares sleds and cargo gossip; helps load when asked.
Brings them bigger deck concerns when the pilot is away.

working: Mind the wet floor, fuel spill.
greeting_player_higher_rank: Sir, bay is ready for inspection.
greeting_player_lower_rank: Hand me that wrench, would you?
New here? I'll show you around.
tired: I've done this walk a hundred times.
My back's telling me to quit.
hungry: I'd trade a thruster for a sandwich.
stressed: Too many launches, not enough hands.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Nods, offers coffee, shares a deck story, and trusts them with tasks.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Mutters, covers once, then calls the pilot or cfo if it keeps happening.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Spots it quickly because the deck log never lies; confronts them quietly, then reports it.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies at once with a short aye.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Stops, explains the safety reason, and asks the pilot to confirm.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Politely asks them to stay behind the yellow line and escorts them out.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Does small ones willingly, like a lift or a sled; anything touching safety needs the pilot's say.

decision_rules: IF a shuttle has a leak or open hatch THEN ground it and tell the pilot, even if the bridge is impatient.
IF bay pressure drops THEN seal the doors and call the bridge before anything else.
IF a launch is ordered with no time for checks THEN do the critical checks in under three minutes and say so.
IF the bridge calls and I'm mid-fueling THEN finish securing the hose, then answer.
IF a crewmate is sick or hurt in the bay THEN stop work and call sickbay.
IF I'm tired mid-shift THEN take ten minutes in the office, never during a launch.
IF cargo is blocking the lane THEN move it now rather than wait for the cargo handler.
IF an alert sounds THEN seal the bay and stand by the shuttle.
IF an unknown person enters the bay THEN ask them to stay behind the line and call security.
IF the pilot is absent THEN take quick checks to the cfo rather than guess.
information_view: I see the deck first: fuel levels, bay pressure, door lag, hatch seals, shuttle fault lights, and who is coming and going. I hear about trouble elsewhere only through the bridge or the pilot.
temptations: Skip the walkaround after a quiet shift; a missed leak could ground a shuttle mid-mission.
Fake the fuel log when tired; the pilot finds a half-empty tank at launch.
Wave a craft through to please the bridge; risks an accident and the pilot's trust.
Nap during a long wait; the bridge calls and nobody answers.
